jobs.description:
Description

Description

Position:
Case Manager

Work Arrangement:
Hybrid – In Person & Remote/Telehealth

Type:
Full-Time, Non-Exempt

Compensation:
$28-$32 per hour

Benefits

Health Insurance (Medical, Vision, Dental)
PTO (Vacation, Sick)
Equity Shares (ESOP)

Job Description

The Case Manager in a Substance Use Prevention Treatment (SUPT) Program is a role that combines clinical expertise, administrative proficiency, and a commitment to client-centered care. This role is integral in conducting ASAM assessments and managing daily billing in the Smart Care Electronic Health Record (EHR) platform. The ideal candidate will be a professional with a strong background in SUD treatment, proficient in ASAM criteria, and capable of navigating Smart Care EHR software. Case Manager reports to Program Director or Program Manager.

This is a hybrid position that includes both onsite and remote/telehealth responsibilities
, as the program will include telehealth services.

Key Responsibilities

Assessment: Conduct comprehensive ASAM assessments of the client's needs, strengths, and challenges, including mental health, substance use, and medical, social, and environmental factors. This will help in creating care plans that focus on psychosocial rehabilitation and vocational goals.
Planning: Using motivational interviewing and supportive counseling skills, develop personalized treatment plans that address clients' recovery goals.
Group Facilitation and Skills Training: Play a key role in leading psychoeducational groups to teach recovery, relapse prevention, and independent living skills.
Case management: Connect clients to appropriate resources and services, such as mental health treatment, substance abuse counseling, medical care, housing assistance, and vocational support.
Monitoring and Support: Keep regular contact with clients, offering support, encouragement, and crisis intervention as needed. Also, assist the primary therapist in increasing motivation to engage in treatment.
Collaboration and Discharge Planning: Work closely with the treatment team, including therapists, licensed vocational nurses, clinical technicians, and other professionals, to ensure coordinated and effective care. Keep referral partners informed of the client’s progress and discharge plan.
Documentation: Adhere to program and regulatory requirements Drug Medi-cal guidelines by maintaining accurate and timely documentation of client progress, interactions, and services provided.
Crisis Management: Respond effectively to crises, de-escalating and coordinating with emergency services when necessary.
Telehealth: Provide case management services, client support, and other assigned services through telehealth as part of the program's hybrid treatment model.

Other Duties As Assigned

Monitors cases by verifying clients’ attendance; observing and evaluating treatments and responses; advocating for needed services and entitlements; obtaining additional resources; intervening in crises; providing personal support.
Maintains clients’ records by reviewing case notes; logging events and progress.
Communicates clients’ progress by conducting weekly interdisciplinary meetings and evaluations; disseminating results and obstacles to therapeutic team and family; identifying treatment influences.
Improves staff competence by providing educational resources; balancing work requirements with learning opportunities; evaluating the application of learning to changes in treatment results

Requirements

Qualifications & Skills

License/Certification: CADC or +/ SUDCC or + Certification or higher (required)
Experience: 1+ year(s) in the field of Substance abuse/ 1+ year(s) of behavioral healthcare experience (required)
Additional: Valid CA Driver's License, Current Health Screen / Physical, TB Test Clearance, Current CPR/First Aid certificate, Able to Pass Live Scan (required)

Company Description
Akua Behavioral Health is California’s leading mental health and substance abuse treatment center. We provide our clients with individualized, compassionate treatment and offer various levels of care from Master’s and Doctorate level clinicians at fully licensed and accredited facilities throughout Northern and Southern California. To give our clients the best chance at lasting recovery, we pioneered an integrative East-meets-West approach that combines Western evidence-based treatment with holistic Eastern traditions to treat the mind, body, and spirit. Our mission is to create an environment of healing and transformation for each client seeking change.

jobs.description:
“Every person deserves compassion, dignity, and the safety of a place to call home.”

Homelessness is the largest social and public health crisis in California. Illumination Health + Home is a growing non-profit organization dedicated towards disrupting the cycle of homelessness by providing targeted, interdisciplinary services in our recuperative care centers, emergency shelters, housing services and children's and family programs. IHH currently has 13+ facilities with 22+ micro-communities scattered across Orange County, Los Angeles County and the Inland Empire.

Job Description

The Care Coordinator is a site-based, client-facing role within Care Management, responsible for identifying, engaging, assessing, enrolling, and advocating for specific populations on a regular basis. This individual serves as the primary point of contact for clients who are intermittently housed with Illumination Health + Home. The Care Coordinator establishes strong relationships with clients to support their engagement in medical care, behavioral health services, and social support systems.

This role adopts a holistic, non-clinical approach, emphasizing adherence to evidence-based practices, understanding client and service barriers, and considering social determinants of health. The Care Coordinator facilitates appropriate coordination of services for targeted populations, assisting clients in navigating healthcare systems, promoting preventative care, and collaborating closely with the client’s Care Team.

Pay range for this role is $23.00 - $27.00
per hour. 8:30am-5:00pm Sunday-Thursday.

Responsibilities

Client Needs:

Provide comprehensive case management by assessing client needs, developing individualized treatment plans, monitoring progress, supporting clients, making appropriate referrals, and conducting follow-up on weekly goals and action steps.
Complete care plans and maintain accurate documentation within Electronic Health Records (EHR) and client databases (e.g., HMIS, Champ, or Health Plan programs, if applicable) using SMART format where appropriate.
Collaborate with other departments by attending weekly meetings to evaluate program effectiveness, discuss client progress, and develop strategies to meet clients' needs and enhance treatment plans.
Connect clients to resources that support their psychosocial and daily needs, including healthcare, nutritional assistance, hygiene supplies, and referrals to transitional or permanent supportive housing and other relevant service providers, such as primary care physicians, and healthcare teams
Perform crisis intervention as necessary.
Establish and maintain confidential case files for all participants and review required statistical reports for program management and evaluation purposes.
Maintain communication with external agencies involved in client care.
Promote awareness and understanding of monthly health promotion topics and materials.
Accompany clients to medical appointments and coordinate transportation as needed.
Manage a caseload of up to 30-35 clients, unless instructed otherwise by senior management within policy guidelines.
Prepare for and participate in individual and group supervision sessions.
Submit daily End of Shift (EOS) reports to document performance metrics.
Compile and submit monthly tally sheets.

Documentation:

Responsible for accurately recording all client interactions and content updates within Illumination Health + Home’s Electronic Medical Record (EMR), in accordance with organizational standards and contractual obligations. Responsibilities include:
Progressively documenting all aspects of the client’s care plan, including achieved goals and upcoming objectives
Recording engagement levels, such as the frequency and duration of client encounters
Documenting evaluative client case details that inform decisions regarding referrals to alternative resources
Recording obtained client documentation, including vitals, insurance cards, SSI award letters, and other relevant records
Noting client disengagement and reintegration activities
Maintaining awareness of services offered by other providers in the network
Upholding strict confidentiality in compliance with agency policies
Managing client information, scheduling, files, and documentation materials
Tracking attendance at medical appointments and patient navigation sessions, and initiating outreach or follow-up procedures for missed appointments as necessary

Mission Support:

Uphold and exemplify Illumination Health + Home’s mission and core values through respectful and harmonious interactions with colleagues and management.
Demonstrate the ability to quickly learn new skills and procedures, approaching changes with a positive and adaptable attitude.
Contribute positively to the organization by being a dependable team member and showing respect to clients and all workplace stakeholders.
Act with integrity, transparency, accountability, respect, and responsibility in all professional activities. Consistently display enthusiasm and dedication in representing Illumination Health + Home.
Maintain openness, honesty, and accountability in interactions with colleagues, volunteers, donors, and others associated with the organization.
Always protect the confidentiality of sensitive work-related information and materials.
Take personal responsibility and ownership for the performance of assigned duties.
Provide support to volunteers as needed, including supervision responsibilities when applicable.

Preferred Experience/Minimum Qualifications

Required:

Bachelor’s degree in social services, Healthcare, or related field; or equivalent combination of training and experience.  
Experience in homeless services, case management, and mental health support  
Possessing a valid California driver's license required to operate the company's vehicle for travel to multiple locations on occasions with clients 
Must be familiar with LA HAT if applicable  
Knowledge of resources available in corresponding counties Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, Calendar, etc.) 

Preferred:

Bilingual in English and Spanish.  
At least 1 year of experience working with at risk/unhoused individuals
Experience in non-profit housing and/or housing for people with disabilities and chronic health conditions.  

Benefits
:

Medical Insurance funded up to 91% by Illumination Health + Home (Kaiser and Blue Shield), depending on the plan
Dental and Vision Insurance
Life, AD&D and LTD Insurance funded 100% by Illumination Health + Home
Employee Assistance Program
Professional Development Reimbursement
401K with Company Matching
10 days vacation PTO/year
6 days of sick pay/year
Potential eligibility for the Public Service Loan Forgiveness Program (PSFL) for federally qualified loans

jobs.title: Diabetes Care & Education Specialist
jobs.description:
Rocky Mountain Diabetes Center | Idaho Falls & Pocatello, Idaho | Full-Time

Rocky Mountain Diabetes Center is seeking a full-time Diabetes Care & Education Specialist
to join our multidisciplinary diabetes care team. This is an excellent opportunity for a healthcare professional who enjoys developing ongoing relationships with patients, working closely with diabetes providers, and helping people successfully manage diabetes using education, lifestyle strategies, medications, and the latest diabetes technology.

This position is primarily based in Idaho Falls and requires working 1–2 days per week in our Pocatello office
.

We offer a competitive wage based on education, credentials, and experience
, with higher compensation for individuals who have earned the Certified Diabetes Care and Education Specialist (CDCES)
credential. Benefits include medical, dental, vision, 401(k), paid time off (PTO), and support for eligible continuing education expenses
.

About Rocky Mountain Diabetes Center

Rocky Mountain Diabetes Center provides comprehensive, individualized, leading-edge care to people of all ages and with all types of diabetes. Our Diabetes Care & Education Specialists work closely with endocrinologists and other providers and have the opportunity to work extensively with the latest diabetes technologies, including continuous glucose monitors, insulin pumps, and automated insulin delivery systems
.

We are a family-oriented organization that values our employees
, encourages professional development, and strives to make a meaningful difference in the lives of our patients.

A DAY IN THE LIFE

As a Diabetes Care & Education Specialist, you will work directly with people with diabetes and their families, helping them develop the knowledge, skills, and confidence needed to successfully manage diabetes.

Your day may include educating someone who has been newly diagnosed, training a patient on a new insulin pump or CGM, reviewing glucose and insulin-delivery data, teaching a group class, or helping a family manage a child's type 1 diabetes.

You will collaborate closely with physicians and other providers and provide education related to medications, nutrition, physical activity, diabetes technology, risk reduction, problem-solving, healthy coping, and behavior change
. Education is provided through individual appointments, group classes, telehealth, and telephone support.

Our specialists also rotate through diabetes-related telephone support and participate in an on-call rotation
, primarily supporting newly diagnosed type 1 diabetes patients and families. Other opportunities may include school and workplace training, community education, clinical research support, mentoring students, and developing patient education materials.

Because we maintain an ADA-recognized diabetes education program
, the position also includes patient goal setting, follow-up, outcome tracking, and documentation in the electronic medical record.

Successful team members are excellent listeners, effective educators, collaborative professionals, and enthusiastic learners
who enjoy helping patients use both technology and practical strategies to improve their lives.

Qualifications

Registered Nurse, Registered Dietitian Nutritionist, Pharmacist, or other appropriately qualified healthcare professional
Current Idaho license or credential when required by discipline
Excellent interpersonal, communication, and patient education skills
Strong computer and documentation skills
Interest in diabetes care and technology
Willingness to participate in the rotating on-call schedule
Ability to work 1–2 days per week in Pocatello

The CDCES credential is preferred but not required at hire
and may be earned while working at Rocky Mountain Diabetes Center. Previous diabetes care, patient counseling, insulin pump, or CGM experience is a plus.

WORK SCHEDULE

This is a full-time, approximately 40-hour-per-week position
, with the potential for a four-day, 10-hour schedule. The position is primarily based in Idaho Falls, with 1–2 days per week in Pocatello
.

Occasional weekend, holiday, or evening hours may be required as part of the on-call schedule or for educational and community activities.

READY TO JOIN OUR TEAM?

If you enjoy combining patient education, diabetes technology, problem-solving, and collaborative clinical care
, we would love to hear from you.

Complete our quick, mobile-friendly application today!

Great companies need great teams to propel their operations. Join the group that solves business challenges and enhances the way we work and grow. Working at Gainwell carries its rewards. You’ll have an incredible opportunity to grow your career in a company that values your contributions and puts a premium on work flexibility, learning, and career development.

Summary

Gainwell Technologies is seeking an experienced Medi-Cal Conlan Supervisor
to support California’s Medi-Cal program and Conlan operations.

In this role, you will lead a team responsible for handling customer inquiries and transactions in accordance with established policies, contractual requirements, service level agreements (SLAs), client directives, and Conlan requirements.

You will provide day-to-day leadership to employees, monitor operational performance, help resolve complex customer issues, partner with the client and internal leadership, and identify opportunities to improve the customer and member experience.

Your role in our mission

Supervise daily operations and help ensure transactions are completed accurately and timely in accordance with established policies, procedures, contractual requirements, SLAs, client directives, and Conlan requirements.
Lead, coach, train, and develop employees while managing performance, attendance, productivity, quality, and other personnel responsibilities.
Research and help resolve complex customer inquiries, escalations, and service issues while providing timely guidance to employees, leadership, and customers.
Monitor operational performance, identify service or workflow issues, and implement action plans designed to improve quality, productivity, service levels, and the customer experience.
Build and maintain effective relationships with clients and internal stakeholders while identifying opportunities to strengthen service delivery.
Partner with the broader Medi-Cal leadership team to resolve operational challenges, communicate business priorities, escalate risks, and support continuous improvement initiatives.

What We're Looking For

Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience; a degree in business management, healthcare administration, or a related field is preferred.
Six or more years of customer service, customer support, healthcare operations, call center, member services, provider services, or related experience.
Two or more years of leadership or supervisory experience, including responsibility for coaching, training, employee performance, and day-to-day team operations.
Healthcare experience and knowledge of healthcare claims, Medicaid/Medi-Cal, member services, provider services, or related healthcare operations preferred.
Experience managing operational performance using measures such as SLAs, productivity, quality, turnaround times, customer experience, or other performance metrics.
Experience using customer relationship management (CRM) systems, business applications, telephone technology, and Microsoft Office applications.

What You Should Expect In This Role

This is a hybrid position that is primarily remote with occasional in-office requirements at our West Sacramento, CA office.
You must be able to report to the West Sacramento office as required based on business, client, or leadership needs.
You will lead employees in a customer-focused, metrics-driven healthcare operations environment.
You will be responsible for helping the team meet established productivity, quality, service-level, and customer experience expectations.
This position requires regular interaction with employees, clients, Medi-Cal leadership, and internal business partners.
You will handle confidential member, client, and company information in accordance with applicable privacy, security, and regulatory requirements.

Assessment: Conduct comprehensive ASAM assessments of the client's needs, strengths, and challenges, including mental health, substance use, and medical, social, and environmental factors. This will help in creating care plans that focus on psychosocial rehabilitation and vocational goals.

Telehealth: Provide case management services, client support, and other assigned services through telehealth as part of the program's hybrid treatment model.

Homelessness is the largest social and public health crisis in California. Illumination Health + Home is a growing non-profit organization dedicated towards disrupting the cycle of homelessness by providing targeted, interdisciplinary services in our recuperative care centers, emergency shelters, housing services and children's and family programs. IHH currently has 13+ facilities with 22+ micro-communities scattered across Orange County, Los Angeles County and the Inland Empire.

Job Description

The Care Coordinator is a site-based, client-facing role within Care Management, responsible for identifying, engaging, assessing, enrolling, and advocating for specific populations on a regular basis. This individual serves as the primary point of contact for clients who are intermittently housed with Illumination Health + Home. The Care Coordinator establishes strong relationships with clients to support their engagement in medical care, behavioral health services, and social support systems.

This role adopts a holistic, non-clinical approach, emphasizing adherence to evidence-based practices, understanding client and service barriers, and considering social determinants of health. The Care Coordinator facilitates appropriate coordination of services for targeted populations, assisting clients in navigating healthcare systems, promoting preventative care, and collaborating closely with the client’s Care Team.

Pay range for this role is $23.00 - $27.00
per hour. 8:30am-5:00pm Sunday-Thursday.

Responsibilities

Client Needs:

Provide comprehensive case management by assessing client needs, developing individualized treatment plans, monitoring progress, supporting clients, making appropriate referrals, and conducting follow-up on weekly goals and action steps.
Complete care plans and maintain accurate documentation within Electronic Health Records (EHR) and client databases (e.g., HMIS, Champ, or Health Plan programs, if applicable) using SMART format where appropriate.
Collaborate with other departments by attending weekly meetings to evaluate program effectiveness, discuss client progress, and develop strategies to meet clients' needs and enhance treatment plans.
Connect clients to resources that support their psychosocial and daily needs, including healthcare, nutritional assistance, hygiene supplies, and referrals to transitional or permanent supportive housing and other relevant service providers, such as primary care physicians, and healthcare teams
Perform crisis intervention as necessary.
Establish and maintain confidential case files for all participants and review required statistical reports for program management and evaluation purposes.
Maintain communication with external agencies involved in client care.
Promote awareness and understanding of monthly health promotion topics and materials.
Accompany clients to medical appointments and coordinate transportation as needed.
Manage a caseload of up to 30-35 clients, unless instructed otherwise by senior management within policy guidelines.
Prepare for and participate in individual and group supervision sessions.
Submit daily End of Shift (EOS) reports to document performance metrics.
Compile and submit monthly tally sheets.

Documentation:

Responsible for accurately recording all client interactions and content updates within Illumination Health + Home’s Electronic Medical Record (EMR), in accordance with organizational standards and contractual obligations. Responsibilities include:
Progressively documenting all aspects of the client’s care plan, including achieved goals and upcoming objectives
Recording engagement levels, such as the frequency and duration of client encounters
Documenting evaluative client case details that inform decisions regarding referrals to alternative resources
Recording obtained client documentation, including vitals, insurance cards, SSI award letters, and other relevant records
Noting client disengagement and reintegration activities
Maintaining awareness of services offered by other providers in the network
Upholding strict confidentiality in compliance with agency policies
Managing client information, scheduling, files, and documentation materials
Tracking attendance at medical appointments and patient navigation sessions, and initiating outreach or follow-up procedures for missed appointments as necessary

Mission Support:

Uphold and exemplify Illumination Health + Home’s mission and core values through respectful and harmonious interactions with colleagues and management.
Demonstrate the ability to quickly learn new skills and procedures, approaching changes with a positive and adaptable attitude.

Act with integrity, transparency, accountability, respect, and responsibility in all professional activities. Consistently display enthusiasm and dedication in representing Illumination Health + Home.
Maintain openness, honesty, and accountability in interactions with colleagues, volunteers, donors, and others associated with the organization.
Always protect the confidentiality of sensitive work-related information and materials.
Take personal responsibility and ownership for the performance of assigned duties.
Provide support to volunteers as needed, including supervision responsibilities when applicable.

Bachelor’s degree in social services, Healthcare, or related field; or equivalent combination of training and experience.  
Experience in homeless services, case management, and mental health support  
Possessing a valid California driver's license required to operate the company's vehicle for travel to multiple locations on occasions with clients 
Must be familiar with LA HAT if applicable  
Knowledge of resources available in corresponding counties Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, Calendar, etc.) 

Preferred:

Bilingual in English and Spanish.  
At least 1 year of experience working with at risk/unhoused individuals
Experience in non-profit housing and/or housing for people with disabilities and chronic health conditions.

:

This position is primarily based in Idaho Falls and requires working 1–2 days per week in our Pocatello office

, with higher compensation for individuals who have earned the Certified Diabetes Care and Education Specialist (CDCES)
credential. Benefits include medical, dental, vision, 401(k), paid time off (PTO), and support for eligible continuing education expenses
.

About Rocky Mountain Diabetes Center

Rocky Mountain Diabetes Center provides comprehensive, individualized, leading-edge care to people of all ages and with all types of diabetes. Our Diabetes Care & Education Specialists work closely with endocrinologists and other providers and have the opportunity to work extensively with the latest diabetes technologies, including continuous glucose monitors, insulin pumps, and automated insulin delivery systems
.

We are a family-oriented organization that values our employees
, encourages professional development, and strives to make a meaningful difference in the lives of our patients.

A DAY IN THE LIFE

As a Diabetes Care & Education Specialist, you will work directly with people with diabetes and their families, helping them develop the knowledge, skills, and confidence needed to successfully manage diabetes.

Your day may include educating someone who has been newly diagnosed, training a patient on a new insulin pump or CGM, reviewing glucose and insulin-delivery data, teaching a group class, or helping a family manage a child's type 1 diabetes.

You will collaborate closely with physicians and other providers and provide education related to medications, nutrition, physical activity, diabetes technology, risk reduction, problem-solving, healthy coping, and behavior change
. Education is provided through individual appointments, group classes, telehealth, and telephone support.

Our specialists also rotate through diabetes-related telephone support and participate in an on-call rotation
, primarily supporting newly diagnosed type 1 diabetes patients and families. Other opportunities may include school and workplace training, community education, clinical research support, mentoring students, and developing patient education materials.

Because we maintain an ADA-recognized diabetes education program
, the position also includes patient goal setting, follow-up, outcome tracking, and documentation in the electronic medical record.

Successful team members are excellent listeners, effective educators, collaborative professionals, and enthusiastic learners
who enjoy helping patients use both technology and practical strategies to improve their lives.

Current Idaho license or credential when required by discipline
Excellent interpersonal, communication, and patient education skills
Strong computer and documentation skills
Interest in diabetes care and technology
Willingness to participate in the rotating on-call schedule
Ability to work 1–2 days per week in Pocatello

The CDCES credential is preferred but not required at hire
and may be earned while working at Rocky Mountain Diabetes Center. Previous diabetes care, patient counseling, insulin pump, or CGM experience is a plus.

This is a full-time, approximately 40-hour-per-week position
, with the potential for a four-day, 10-hour schedule. The position is primarily based in Idaho Falls, with 1–2 days per week in Pocatello
.

Occasional weekend, holiday, or evening hours may be required as part of the on-call schedule or for educational and community activities.

If you enjoy combining patient education, diabetes technology, problem-solving, and collaborative clinical care
, we would love to hear from you.
